question: Choose the figure which is different from the rest?
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/451f3e56ccfd450580ec1001e44d7095cde8f39769ad94bcfe4f70c5f49bb8ff.png] → The number of shaded elements are equal to number of non-shaded elements.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e6bdc3f58a4e9f577a7acd61691d7fa67bd59d1d95fe59391d1e7ca8fef73d5.png] → The number of shaded elements are equal to number of non-shaded elements.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c405e6284492c9828d87f4b25801187b9332f28f8da8ac517adcf4329a17cb80.png] → The number of shaded elements are equal to number of non-shaded elements.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b8858cb4f905e8aad75f4d5baed7a928233fe202cea08bc62257a5ec9efcb53.png] → The number of shaded elements are more than number of non-shaded elements.*​*

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
